description: Background app service — auto-titles a chat ONCE from its first few user messages using a tiny LLM call, then locks the name so it never changes again. Runs after every turn on its own; the agent never invokes it. Turn it off to leave chats on their default 'New chat' name (or to save the small per-chat naming cost).
note: Runs automatically after each turn — a background app function, not an agent tool. Its on/off lives in App Settings ▸ App Functions.
